welcome_sub: Analyze your sound. Perfect your music.
formats: Drag & Drop MP3, WAV, FLAC and more.
wave_help: Drag the region edges to select audio. Double-click to seek. Scroll to zoom; drag to pan.
master_intro: Shape the balance, dynamics and loudness of your finished mix. All processing stays local.
dsp_explanation: 25 Hz high-pass blend → adaptive three-band EQ (bounded corrections) → linked soft-knee compression → mid/side width → LUFS gain → look-ahead peak envelope limiter → 4× oversampled peak check. Intensity blends processing and loudness targets. Zero intensity bypasses the chain.
master_note: Violet: original · Pink: mastered. Crest factor is a dynamics indicator, not EBU loudness range.
history_hint: Analysis summaries are saved locally. Audio files are not copied into history.
privacy: Audio is processed locally. History and preferences stay on this computer. Logs may contain local file paths.
busy: An operation is running. Cancel it or wait for completion.
confidence_note: Heuristic score, not a statistical probability.
no_key: Insufficient tonal evidence; no reliable key.
ambiguous_key: Key is ambiguous; compare the candidates.
changing_key: Local key estimates vary across the track.
sampled_analysis: Quick analysis uses excerpts; spectrogram time is approximate between excerpts.
uncertain_tempo: Tempo is uncertain or no stable beat was found.
changing_tempo: Tempo estimates vary across the track.
no_master: Run mastering to create a processed version.
target_limited: The measured loudness differs from the requested target: peak protection or gain limits took priority.
aggressive: These settings are aggressive; listen carefully for distortion and stereo compatibility.
export_note: Integer PCM uses TPDF dither. FLAC supports 16/24-bit. MP3 encoding may introduce new peaks; leave headroom.
confirm_clear: Delete all saved analysis summaries? Audio files will remain on disk.
wait_cancel: Cancellation requested. Close the window again when the operation has stopped.
missing_file: The file is no longer available.
channels_error: Only mono and stereo audio are supported.
too_large: This file exceeds the memory safety limit (512 MB decoded / 129.6 million frames). Use a shorter excerpt.
too_short: Audio is too short. Analysis needs at least 0.5 seconds.
codec_error: The audio could not be decoded or encoded. Check the file and format.
original_protected: Choose a different filename. The original audio is protected.
invalid_settings: Some processing settings are outside the supported range.
write_error: Could not write the file. Check folder permissions and free disk space.
operation_error: The operation failed. Details were written to the local KEYWAVE log.
playback_error: Playback failed. Check the output device and try loading the file again.
no_device: No audio output device is available.
youtube_intro: Preview and download one video as MP3 or MP4.
youtube_quality_note: MP4 quality is a maximum: a lower resolution is used if needed. Higher MP3 bitrate cannot improve the source. Download only content you have permission to save. No access restrictions are bypassed.
youtube_invalid: Enter a valid YouTube video link (not a channel or playlist).
youtube_runtime: The YouTube runtime is missing. Reinstall the complete KEYWAVE folder.
youtube_unavailable: Download failed. Check the connection and video availability. YouTube may require sign-in or an updated downloader. Live streams are not supported.
vocal_formats: Dry solo vocal · WAV, MP3, FLAC, M4A
vocal_method: pYIN + pitch-synchronous overlap-add. Intended for dry, single-voice recordings; not mixed music. BPM controls the visual beat grid only.
vocal_pitch_note: Violet: detected pitch · Pink: synthesis pitch curve (not a new measurement of the result). Double-click waveform to seek.
vocal_no_pitch: No reliable voiced notes detected. Unvoiced audio was preserved.
youtube_quality_unavailable: No available video stream matches this quality.
